title: Orthologists vs. Neologists: A Cultural War
grammar: Abstract noun derivations (-ság/-ség) and ideological nominalizations
goal: I can explain the pamphlet war between the Orthologists (Mondolat, 1813) and the Neologists (Felelet a Mondolatra, 1815).
I can form -ság/-ség nouns from adjectives (merész -> merészség) and use them in a sentence.
I can explain what Kazinczy's 1819 essay says about tradition and innovation.
